case.title: Pump housing PH-100: the foundry wants +8.8 %
case.briefing: Demo Gießerei GmbH, our single source for the grey-iron pump housing PH-100 for 12 years, announces +8.8 % from 1 December citing energy and wages. Castings are a strategic category: the goal is to stabilise supply with a healthy partner, so squeezing the foundry below a 4 % margin costs us (from EUR 5,000 per margin point and year). We need 4,000 housings a year for the next two years; anything not covered by this deal costs EUR 55.00 per unit (spot buys and a second source). Price, payment terms, contract length and the date the new price applies are open; lead time and Incoterm are fixed.

sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. 

For twelve years, our family foundry has taken great pride in supplying Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH with quality craftsmanship from our region. We greatly value our twelve-year partnership and welcome the planning security that a 24-month commitment provides. 

We are prepared to accept the extended contract term and the February 2027 effective date, provided we agree on a unit price of €51.50. Therefore, our current Angebot stands at a price of €51.50 per unit, a Zahlungsziel of 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, and is valid from 1 February 2027. This proposal remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our reliable cooperation for many years to come.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to deal with our valued partners at Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH. Over our twelve-year partnership, we have always aimed to provide the highest craftsmanship and reliability for your production.

Regarding our current negotiations, as we have already reached the absolute limit of what is economically viable for our family foundry, we must hold our price at €50.70 per unit. This is our final offer (letztes Angebot), and we trust it provides a fair basis to conclude our negotiations and continue our twelve-year partnership. Please decide soon, as this offer remains valid for 7 days.

For complete clarity, our offer consists of a price of €50.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 February 2027.

We look forward to your decision and to continuing our good cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
